fields.climate: temperate; cool summers; cold, cloudy, humid winters
fields.terrain: Bohemia in the west consists of rolling plains, hills, and plateaus surrounded by low mountains; Moravia in the east consists of very hilly country
fields.resources: hard coal, soft coal, kaolin, clay, graphite, timber, arable land
fields.farm: wheat, sugar beets, milk, barley, rapeseed, potatoes, maize, triticale, pork, chicken
fields.exports: cars, vehicle parts/accessories, broadcasting equipment, computers, plastic products
fields.industries: motor vehicles, metallurgy, machinery and equipment, glass, armaments
fields.religions: Roman Catholic 7%, other believers belonging to a church or religious society 6% (includes Evangelical United Brethren Church and Czechoslovak Hussite Church), believers unaffiliated with a religious…

independence.event: Czechoslovakia split into the Czech Republic and Slovakia

fields.legal: new civil code enacted in 2014, replacing civil code of 1964 based on former Austro-Hungarian civil codes and socialist theory
fields.military: 18-28 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; conscription abolished 2004
